lines: Supreme-light-bodied — thought-power, Lord — goddess supreme;
hers indeed the spreading — all goddesses, Brahmī-led.
sanskrit_cite: paramaprakāśavapuṣo vimarśaśaktiḥ prabho parā devī | asyā eva prasaraḥ sarvā brāhmyādikā devyaḥ

lines: Fire, water, nectar-streak, poison — bearing, You show this;
world opposed though — in true-knowing-formed, in me unopposed — not this.
sanskrit_cite: dahanajalāmṛtalekhāviṣādi bibhrat tvam ādiśasy etat | viśvaṃ viruddham api saccidrūpe mayi virudhyate naitat

lines: Knowing-thread loosed, sapless knower-crowd —
sense-skull-garlanded You show — as it were — to us, Lord.
sanskrit_cite: saṃvitsūtranilīno niḥsāro mātṛnivaho 'yam | karaṇamuṇḍamālabhārin darśayasītīva naḥ svāmin

lines: Look, look — hostile nooses — those, these, outcast ever;
gut-holding as it were, speaking — appear to us.
sanskrit_cite: paśyata paśyata pāśā viṣamās ta ime bahiṣkṛtāḥ śaśvat | antradhāraṇamiṣat kathayaṃs tvaṃ naḥ samābhāsi

lines: Māyā-cloth, impassioned, in highest heaven — there cast — that, this;
elephant-hide, bloodied, head-borne — You tell, Lord.
sanskrit_cite: māyāpaṭaḥ sarāgo vyomni pare 'smin sa eṣa nikṣiptaḥ | gajacarma saraktaṃ mūrdhni vahan kathayasīśa

lines: Inward-power dagger bared — world-round splitting — by sword;
world by own power-glory taken — best heroes indeed.
sanskrit_cite: antaḥśaktikṛpāṇīm vyanakṣi saṃsṛtivibhedinīm asinā | nijaśaktimahimasvīkṛtasamastaviśvā hi vīravarāḥ

lines: World-fear slayer — he, I, lorded, standing — am. Fear not.
So shield-clash shown — point us, Lord.
sanskrit_cite: bhavabhayahantā so 'ham sānāthye 'vasthito 'smi | mā bhaiṣṭa ity āsphoṭitakheṭakadarśanato diśasi naḥ svāmin

lines: Self-power-noosed, by knowing-body, I count time;
so by noose-holding show us death's death — You.
sanskrit_cite: nijaśaktipāśavalitaś cidvapuṣā kalyate mayā kālaḥ | pāśadhāraṇavaśāt prathayasi naḥ kālakālas tvam

lines: Difference-made, all, this — by own power I hurl to unmake;
so goad-held makes plain — supreme Bhairava, to us.
sanskrit_cite: bhedamayam akhilam etan nijaśaktyaivākṣipāmi saṃhartum | aṅkuśadhāraṇataḥ sphuṭayati parabhairavo 'smākam

lines: Drawn bow, nocked arrow shown — Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra-lords with Sadākhya-Śivas —
by power the cause-deer pierced deer-like — You.
sanskrit_cite: kodaṇḍārūdhaśarapradarśanād | brahmaviṣṇurudreśān sasadākhyaśivāñ chaktyā kāraṇahariṇaṃ bhinatsi mṛgavat tvam
